title: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean: Lean companion to the second moment of the Stratonovich hyperbolic Anderson model
description: Lean 4 checks of the finite, algebraic, scalar and selected analytic steps of the paper on the second moment of the Stratonovich hyperbolic Anderson model with time-dependent noise. Each Lean statement is mapped to the manuscript label it supports in docs/statement-ledger.md; analytic and probabilistic inputs that stay outside Lean enter as explicit named hypotheses. This is a partial formalization, not an end-to-end verification of the paper. The correspondence between the Lean statements and the paper was checked by AI review, not by a human reader. Release v0.11.0 is the wave-L15 to wave-L21 gates, the end point of the Lean work, with every manuscript line citation at the book's release 1.1.3; every compared theorem is either credited to a manuscript result in coverage.yaml or compared in a separate helper configuration declared a smoke check.
